q: Our Saltillo foundry casts engine and chassis parts. How do we give the carmaker a carbon figure?
title: Saltillo auto casting carbon data
short: Add melting energy, whether electricity for induction furnaces or gas, plus coke if you run a cupola, then add metal bought in: scrap at near zero, pig iron and alloys at supplier figures. Divide by good castings, not metal melted.
audience: Iron and aluminium foundries in Saltillo and Ramos Arizpe supplying carmakers

ul: Induction furnace electricity, at the Mexican grid factor.
Gas for aluminium melting and holding.
Purchased scrap, returns and pig iron.
Sand binders, if the buyer asks for a full footprint.

p: Runners, risers and rejects are remelted, so divide by good castings shipped and state the yield.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
